results.title: Geriga
results.overview: In the remote village of Naivad, Kerala, villagers follow GERIGA, a sacred ritual to summon the dead. Desperate for viral fame, Vijay and his four YouTuber friends stage the ritual as a hoax, but horror strikes when Vijay is possessed just as news breaks of his father's sudden death. Now, the group must fight supernatural forces and finish the ritual in twelve days to free him before time runs out.

results.title: Fatman: The Shape of Fear
results.overview: After his parents mysteriously vanish at the hands of the sinister Scarecloud, a determined crimefighter known as Fatman sets out to uncover the truth behind their disappearance. As fear spreads throughout the city, Fatman must confront his greatest enemy and face his darkest fears before everything he fights to protect is lost.

results.title: Jennifer
results.overview: Jennifer is an Indian movie directed by Althaf Rahman starring Swasika. The feature film is produced by Antony Naduvattom and Binu Dev

results.title: Love Story Abhimanyu Ki
results.overview: Torn between her first love, Wasim Akhtar, and Abhimanyu Yadav, whom her family pressures her to marry, a simple girl faces a complex journey. Struggling with personal trauma and social expectations, she must navigate her emotions to choose her own path.

results.title: Destin Morillo’s The Noah Movie;The Complete Epic
results.original_title: Destin Morillo’s The Noah Movie;The Complete Epic
results.overview: Noah Feliz, A big time gangster, is offered a chance to make some big money when a narcotics/gangster Brian Thompson pays him a visit. But things go wrong very quickly. Watch how the story unfolds in this gangster epic. With acts of violence, betrayal, and fights for power. No one is safe.

results.title: Ilya Sobolev: Society
results.overview: Ilya Sobolev talks about current issues in our society and the challenging path toward one’s dream.

results.title: IN OUR OWN WORDS
results.overview: A documentary short exploring Black identity, culture, and belonging in an international school setting. Featuring unfiltered conversations and personal truths.

results.title: Banana Split
results.overview: While waiting for a costume party to start, a conversation about career paths spark between two best friends in matching banana costumes. This seemingly comedic yet quiet moment between them marks the beginning of a change that will shift their friendship forever as one of them, Julia, progressively turns into a banana.
When Trize notices that her friend, Mia, disappears every day at exactly 12:12 to make a private phone call, she becomes determined to find out who’s on the other end.

results.overview: When a girl’s heirloom umbrella mistakenly gets taken by the student next door, she finds herself caught in a chaotic chase to retrieve the one thing she cannot afford to lose.

results.overview: A wistful college girl, grows an insatiable longing for another girl who seems to follow her everywhere she goes. But whenever she tries to close the distance between them, chance seems to always pull them apart.

results.title: Jhaad Phoonk
results.overview: Jhaad Phoonk is a horror-drama directed by Rajan Ramgopal Verma. The movie features Padmini Kolhapure, Sumbul Touqeer, Yashpal Sharma, and Harsh Rajput in pivotal roles.

results.title: Siddhartha Suburbia
results.overview: A short avant-garde film by Šimon Vaitovič, his first cinematic work. The story of a young man who believes he is beginning to experience a spiritual awakening in a world he feels a deep distaste for. Yet something is not quite right.

results.title: One Night Stand
results.overview: A married man's reckless decision to cheat during a night out spirals into a deadly nightmare when his mysterious hookup turns out to be a calculated serial killer targeting unfaithful men. As she embeds herself deeper into his life-stalking him, infiltrating his workplace, and getting dangerously close to his pregnant wife-he's forced to confront the consequences of his betrayal before everything he loves is destroyed.
